elements.text:
You're working on your math homework with a few friends and get stuck on a problem. Your friend suggests that you find the answer online, but that's considered cheating on the assignment. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I'll feel so proud that I did the homework on my own if I don't cheat
I am upset at my friends wanting me to take the easy way out.
I'll be pretty confident knowing I can do hard homework problems next time.
I feel embarrassed about not wanting to cheat, but know my friends will look up to me if I don't.
I'm nervous about attempting to do this problem on my own, but give it a try anyway.
